**Evidence**

*Files modified/created:*
- `uikit/table.go` (new) — `Column`, `TableRow`, `Table`, `NewTable`, `SetRows`, `SetSort`, `SetSortFunc`, `OnSelect`, `OnActivate`, `Container`, `Sync`, `Refit`
- `uikit/overview.go` (reworked) — Overview is now a `WindowPanel` whose body is a Table; kept `FitColumns`/`ColWidth`/`Ellipsize`/formatters (API unchanged, `FitColumns` now delegates to a generic priority `fitColumns`), added `Kit.AddWindow`, `Kit.panelEnv`, `formatCredits/Volume/Pct`; `drawTints` remains as kit.go's Draw seam (no-op — rows carry their own tints)
- `uikit/selected.go` (reworked) — Approach/Warp/Stop kept + Lock/Dock/Jump/Loot/Mine, all `Info`-flag gated (warp by `CanWarp` like `ui.ActionsFor`, mine mirrors `ui.mineSelected` first-laser-slot lookup)
- `uikit/market.go`, `uikit/inventory.go`, `uikit/fitting.go` (new, all `WindowPanel`)
- `cmd/enui-spike/main.go` — mounts all five windows via `kit.AddWindow`, keys `I/F/G` toggle them, syncs panels per frame
- `uikit/kit_test.go` (adapted to reworked internals), `uikit/table_test.go` (new), `uikit/windows_test.go` (new)

*Tests:* `TestTableSortAscDescStable`, `TestTableSortFunc`, `TestTableSelectVsActivate`, `TestTableSetRowsKeepsSelection`, `TestTableRefitOnResize`, `TestTableRightAlignAnchors`, `TestTableTintAssignment`; `TestOverviewRowClickSelectsThenApproaches`, `TestSelectedButtonsEnqueueCommands` (extended), `TestSelectedContextGating`, `TestOverviewMinSizeAndRefit`, `TestDrawSmoke` (rewritten); `TestMarketGatingAndEnqueue`, `TestInventoryTransferAndSell`, `TestFittingActions`, `TestStationWindowsDrawSmoke`.

*How Table beats `widget.List`:* one owned `widget.ScrollContainer` (`ScrollTop` readable, wheel scaled by measured overflow); each row is a real `widget.Container` with a nine-slice tint background (hostile/player/selection — no more post-draw `drawTints` pass) and its own deferred click handler (select vs. 350 ms activate via timing state); columns are `widget.Text` cells pinned by **both** `MinSize` and `RowLayoutData.MaxWidth`, tiled by cumulative rounding so right-aligned cells share exact per-column anchors; headers are sort buttons with ▲/▼ + amber active image (`Button.SetImage`). The root is a 2-row **grid** (header fixed / scroll fills) so the content's tall preferred height can never leak into the viewport.

*API friction:* (1) events are deferred — constructor handlers need a first `UI.Update`, tests pump explicitly; (2) no vertical stretch in `RowLayout` — window bodies with tables must be grids (fixed rows + stretched table rows), mirrored from the window chrome itself; (3) `widget.Button` can't ellipsize or restyle at runtime beyond `SetText/SetImage`; (4) header buttons overflow when shrunk below their text, so `MinWidth` floors include the sort indicator.

*Demo:* live frame captured at `/tmp/opencode/mine.png` — all five windows over the world: Overview sorted "Distance ▲" with tints/anchors, Market with wallet title + disabled Buy/Sell (undocked), Inventory with per-section totals ("Cargo · 165.5 m³ / 400.0 m³"), Fitting with stat block + `15% 20% 25% 30%` resist table + slot/hangar tables, Selected with 9 gated action buttons. Found & fixed two visual bugs via capture: a float-rounding ellipsis (`25%`→`2…`) and a one-frame pre-fit overflow (converges one frame after first layout — verified `fittedFor=370`, sum exact).

*Sim API assumptions:* `Sim.Market(sys.ID)` is live stock (not `SystemDef.Market`); `Docked.Set/Has` used directly to test the docked gate; `CmdLoot{Wreck}` with empty Item = everything; hangar items/modules are addressable as `content.ItemID`; `Fittings.Get` returns a pointer mutated in-test to create a free slot; fitting actions are only *gated by selection* (sim validates docking/fitting itself), market/sell/hangar-transfer are gated by `Docked.Has(Player)`.

**Known imperfections**
- `kit_test.go` (not strictly in my ownership list) had to be rewritten: it tested the old List internals (`Row`, `sortRows`, `ov.list/page/rowH`) that the mandated rework removed. Coverage was preserved/extended, nothing was deleted without replacement.
- One-frame column overflow before the first post-layout refit (ebiten ran 5 Updates before first Draw in the harness; imperceptible in the real loop).
- At default sizes the compact windows ellipsize long names/prices (Kind shows `Pl…` in a 380 px Overview) — by design of the shrink priorities; windows are resizable.
- Market's grown Item column and Fitting's grown EM resist header are wider than siblings (single grow-column semantics, same as legacy `FitColumns`→Name).
- No visible scrollbar; wheel scroll only (upgrade path commented in `fitColumns`).

**Blockers:** none.
